page_title: Control configuration of power on/off mode and delay
page_content:
[TOC]

### Prerequisites
- A usable remote control and normal display screen

### Operation steps
1.Enter the main menu function interface, operate the direction keys and ENTER key of the remote control, and enter the settings-basic settings-power on/off menu
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=8529df093c1023a3882ffff59be83742)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=29024f147779df6cd6cc568489ed9369)
2.Select "Ignition Mode," check the "Power-off Delay" checkbox, enter the desired delay duration (range: 0–65535 minutes), and configure which cameras remain active during the ACC disconnection delay period.
ps: The vehicle ACC ignition device is turned on and works, and the ACC disconnection device is turned off. For wiring, refer to "[Power line wiring installation](http://pug2.4000329988.com/web/#/13/181 "Power Cord Wiring Installation")" Ignition mode schematic diagram introduction.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=b1842a3a8e9c8ead025ad0f2a2df8437)
3.Select "Timer Mode" and enter the scheduled start time and shutdown time
ps: Wiring reference "[Power Cord Wiring Installation](http://pug2.4000329988.com/web/#/13/181 "Power Cord Wiring Installation")" Timer Mode Schematic diagram introduction
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=ca863f3f7e6c168fb3aba3a5f54477ef)
4.Select "Ignition off mode" to support waking up and starting the machine for a period of time in the shutdown state due to collision and other situations (not yet implemented)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=c559f820bd313fe845ce46239c70c5cf)
